summary: Existing MainWindow accepts an optional recorder and records only applied/rejected samples and capture errors. Overlay payload adds optional first-rejection diagnostics while keeping original conditions and coordinates; baseline function comparison covers eleven input cases with and without diagnostics. Existing overlay tick forwards decisions only when explicitly enabled by an injected recorder. Standard-library QueueHandler/QueueListener own JSONL I/O; state/performance allowlists exclude notes, chat, keys and raw OCR. Runtime Qt topLevelWidgets enumerates visible surfaces and shared page classes without reading titles; weak references retain surface numbering without extending widget lifetime. Explicit launcher alone enables recording; ordinary startup remains disabled. Replay converts recorded snapshot run_id to RunState id and alternates enabled/disabled rounds after warmup. No overlay threshold, renewal, OCR, game input, chat, or UI architecture change.
